Two components in the patient chart app call `useAbortController`, so a behaviour change in the framework hook could affect both. I found them with a text search of the checkout and did not search the other repositories. I also did not read the full component bodies, so the line ranges below are approximate.

1. **`ExportedVitalsAndBiometricsForm`** in `esm-patient-vitals-app`.
   - It gets the hook at line 87.
   - It passes `abortController` at lines 231 and 267, which look like the calls that save vitals and biometrics.
2. **`ExportedLabResultsForm`** in `esm-patient-orders-app`.
   - It gets the hook at line 70.
   - It uses `abortController` in `fetchSavedLabResults(order, abortController)` at line 254, and passes it at lines 304 and 338, which look like the result save calls.
